![](images/a8/a89a9c2ff1cfd53a9d9e33c60591b482cbfa4044e313b2d2c031046bb21e5ce3.png)

The vector $\mathbf{a}$ is depicted above. Which of the following diagrams shows the vectors $3\mathbf{a}$ and $-\mathbf{a}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: Multiplying by $3$ preserves direction and triples length. Multiplying by $-1$ reverses direction and preserves length. The correct diagram therefore has a long vector pointing northeast labeled $3a$, and a vector one-third as long pointing southwest labeled $-a$.
